candidates.summary: A cgroup at its memory.max reads Available 0, ReadMemInfo reports that as a failed read, and resize returns without shrinking or advancing lastCheck (round 1's finding, unchanged at head)
candidates.failure_scenario: Container or systemd slice with memory.max; the budget ramped to 6-8 while memory was free; a second suite in the same cgroup fills it so memory.current - inactive_file >= memory.max. clampToCgroup yields Available 0 (the 'usage at the limit' case TestClampToCgroup pins), parallel_linux.go:62 returns ok=false, resize keeps the ramped limit, and every script that ends hands its slot to a waiter, admitting a node into a full cgroup, where 1 byte free would have cut the limit. lastCheck is not advanced either, so every blocked script's 200ms poll re-reads /proc/meminfo, /proc/self/cgroup and three files per ancestor cgroup. The body's 'pushed past its limit, the budget still shrinks 8 -> 4' holds only while inactive_file keeps used below the limit.
